1.consolidated_definition: Planta herbácea perenne de más de 1 m de altura, de tallo erecto y hojas grandes alternas, de color verde pálido, que despiden un olor ligeramente acre debido a la nicotina; tiene flores verde-amarillentas o rosadas y fruto capsular; de sus hojas se extrae la mayor parte del tabaco consumido hoy en el mundo. Solanaceae; Nicotiana tabacum.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Perennial herbaceous plant over 1 m in height, with an erect stem and large alternate leaves of pale green color, which emit a slightly bitter odor due to nicotine; it has green-yellow or pinkish flowers and a capsular fruit; the majority of the tobacco consumed worldwide is extracted from its leaves. Solanaceae; Nicotiana tabacum.
